study.title: Conceptual 1 MW CRAH loop: fixed- and variable-speed pumping
study.status: Independent educational simulation; illustrative hardware and hydraulic losses
study.boundary: Closed secondary loop, pump set, common supply/return headers, equivalent balanced CRAH coil/control-valve bank, and secondary side of external-plant heat exchanger. Refrigeration, air side and primary pumps excluded.

thermal.note: Maintain 5 K across equivalent coils at all studied loads. Required flow scales with load. This is a thermal demand assumption, not a coil or rack-temperature verification. Pump heat is additional external-plant duty, excluded from the 1 MW coil heat balance.

water.density_viscosity_source: ITTC 7.5-02-01-03 revision 02 (2011), Table 1, page 6, 15 C row. Density 999.1026 kg/m3 and viscosity 0.001138 Pa s at 0.101325 MPa.
water.cp_source: Calculated from IAPWS SR6-08(2011), Table 2 page 5 with Table 1 coefficients page 4 at 288.15 K: 4188.546017894 J/(kg K), rounded. Section 2.4 permits cp at atmospheric pressure to be taken equal to cp at 0.1 MPa. See water_properties.py and published Table 8 checks.
water.note: Reference pressure is for property evaluation, not the selected loop fill pressure. Ignore modest liquid-property pressure dependence. No glycol.

network.classification: Illustrative equivalent turbulent-flow head budgets; not measured or dimensioned pipework
network.note: All common losses scale as (total flow / design total flow)^2. Each pump-branch loss scales as (its branch flow / design per-pump flow)^2. Branch budget includes branch pipework, two fully open isolation valves and one forward-flow check valve. Off branches carry zero flow with functioning check valves; failed branch isolated. Coil bank and its synchronized two-way valves are lumped equivalents, not coils connected in series.

pumps.classification: Entirely illustrative curves and operating envelope; no equipment selected
pumps.note: Choose per-pump BEP flow = design total / 2 and BEP head = 24 m before constructing H = 32*s^2 - 8*(q/q_BEP)^2. Efficiency = 0.80 - 0.35*(q/(s*q_BEP)-1)^2, valid only in declared flow envelope. Efficiencies, motor rating and limits are educational assumptions, not manufacturer guarantees. Off pump input power = 0; auxiliaries omitted. Reference BEP flow and network reference total flow are now explicit fixed hardware inputs; editing thermal duty does not automatically resize the hardware.

control.mode: Fixed nominal speed, minimum feasible duty-pump count, equivalent two-way valve modulates to total required flow
control.note: Evaluate each candidate pump count at requested flow, solve required valve resistance, enforce speed/flow/valve/motor limits, then independently intersect pump and selected system curves. No bypass. No transient simulation, hysteresis or timing model. Standby restores lost duty position after a pump outage.

comparison.classification: Illustrative study assumptions; no measured operating profile or real equipment selection
comparison.pressure_strategy: Idealised remote terminal differential-pressure reset, with valve flow control and speed/flow limit overrides
comparison.pressure_sensor_location: Across representative balanced CRAH coil and equivalent two-way control valve; upstream common pipes/HX and individual pump branches excluded from remote reading
comparison.minimum_pressure_note: Remote terminal DP at least 2 m water (~19.6 kPa), and at least the hydraulic coil plus fully-open valve drop. A control/service floor, not static elevation. This illustrative value is not manufacturer validated.
comparison.staging_rule: Fewest feasible duty pumps, maximum two, for BOTH strategies. At 40/70/100% the base schedule is 1/2/2. Alternative staging is a separately labelled challenge, excluded from headline annual energy.

reference.description: 40% of hours at 40% load, 40% at 70%, 20% at 100%; entirely illustrative

sensitivity.resistance_definition: Multiplier applies to common pipes, plant HX, coil bank and each pump branch. Control valve capacity/rangeability remain those of unchanged hardware.
sensitivity.range_interpretation: Bounded scenario envelope, not a probability distribution or confidence interval. Infeasible duty cases have no comparable annual-energy estimate.

comparison.outage_note: Remove P1, P2 and P3 in turn. Classify role before removal from normal dispatch. No failed-branch leakage. Final steady state after successful substitution only. Annual profile represents normal operation; failure frequencies, durations and starting/standby energy omitted.
